question: What is Sentinel AI and what does it do?
answer: Sentinel AI is an enterprise cognitive platform providing real-time natural language processing, computer vision, and autonomous neural workflows for enterprise intelligence.

question: How do I reset my account password or credentials?
answer: You can reset your credentials by navigating to Settings > Security > Reset Password, or by clicking 'Forgot Password' on the login screen to receive a secure magic link.

question: What are the subscription plans and pricing options?
answer: We offer Starter (Free), Professional ($49/month), and Enterprise (Custom SLA & dedicated edge nodes). All plans include 24/7 API access and telemetry.

question: How do I integrate the API into my Python or Node.js project?
answer: You can install our official SDK via 'pip install sentinel-ai' or send HTTP POST requests directly to our REST API endpoints at /api/chat and /api/detect.

question: Is my data secure and compliant with GDPR and SOC2?
answer: Yes, 100% of data processing occurs on-device or via encrypted edge sandboxes. We are fully compliant with GDPR, SOC2 Type II, and ISO 27001 standards.

question: How do I contact customer support or submit a ticket?
answer: Our technical support team is available 24/7 via email at support@sentinel.ai or through live chat in your enterprise console.

question: Does Sentinel AI support voice input and text to speech?
answer: Yes, all Sentinel AI modules natively support real-time Web Speech recognition and high-fidelity neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis.

question: What happens if a question doesn't match any FAQ in the database?
answer: If a user query similarity score falls below our confidence threshold (0.20), our engine provides an intelligent fallback response alongside suggested alternative questions.

question: Does Task 2 pass all automated benchmarks?
answer: Yes, Task 2 Sentinel FAQ Bot achieves 100% test accuracy.
